assumptions: Primary topology/cache/partial softmax merge and stage-transfer concepts only. Authored contiguous PCP chunks, fixed-capacity contiguous DCP slots, three-reduction stable merge, artificial rates and standalone attention stages are explicit mathematical choices, not a literal vLLM kernel/cache implementation or full model.

Two consecutive synthetic GQA attention/residual blocks on distinct physical stage devices. Each stage owns its full weights and K/V state; a single microbatch traverses both stages serially. No claim of steady-state pipeline overlap or a full language model.
